title: NoEntityLag
description:
So this mod DOES NOT OPTIMIZE.
But why you need it its like an anticheat that blocks lag machines.
body:
⚡ NoEntityLag | Minecraft 1.21.10
Stop lag machines before they crash your server! 🚫

✨ Features
🔴 Smart Redstone Limiting: Automatically detects and stops laggy redstone contraptions

🧟 Entity Overload Protection: Prevents entity-based lag machines from overwhelming your server

⚙️ Fully Configurable: Customize limits via simple JSON configuration

🎮 Player-Friendly: Only affects non-player entities, your gameplay stays smooth!

🌐 Server-Side Only: Clients don't need to install anything

⚡ Silent Operation: No annoying alerts - just pure performance protection

🛡️ How It Works
When a chunk exceeds configurable performance thresholds:

⏸️ Redstone Freeze: Non-player redstone updates are paused for 20 seconds

🛑 Entity Halt: Non-player entities stop processing temporarily

🔄 Auto-Resume: Normal operation resumes automatically after the cooldown period

📦 Requirements
Minecraft: 1.21.10 (Java Edition)

Loader: Fabric

Dependencies: Fabric API

Installation: Server-side only!

⚙️ Configuration
Customize everything via config/noentitylag.json:

🚀 Installation
Install Fabric on your server

Add Fabric API to your mods folder

Drop NoEntityLag.jar into the mods folder

Configure to your liking in the config folder

Restart and enjoy a lag-free server! 🎉

❤️ Perfect For
🏰 Public Servers - Protect against griefers

🎪 Minigame Networks - Ensure smooth gameplay

🏡 Survival Communities - Stop accidental lag machines

🔧 Server Administrators - Zero maintenance protection

Keep your server running smoothly without interrupting legitimate gameplay! 🌟

Note: This mod only affects server performance, no client modifications needed!
